Photo 1 shows a dark patterned bedsheet with two pillowcases and a bolster cover.

Watermarks for 'BIG-WIN SALES LIMITED' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible on all images.

No size tags or physical measurements are shown in the photos.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's material composition tag.

risks.risk: The set may not include the pillowcases or bolster covers shown in the marketing photos.
risks.proof: A photo of the item in its retail packaging showing the list of contents.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single flat sheet

risks.risk: The colors may bleed or fade significantly after the first wash.
risks.proof: A photo of the care label or a manufacturer's guarantee of colorfastness.

proof_requests: Photo of the retail packaging showing the size and included pieces.
Close-up photo of the fabric tag showing material percentage (e.g., 100% Cotton).
Photo of the actual stock in a warehouse or home to confirm the seller possesses the items.
response.reason: The items are identified as bedsheet sets. Because the photos are generic catalog images, the item is priced at the worst-case scenario for material quality and set completeness.
